changes.from: Out of scope-ish: an industrial inspection mobile manipulator, not a general humanoid. Not related to CASBOT despite similar names (some aggregators conflate them). Launched Aug 19, 2025; mass production from June 16, 2026. Maker says it moves autonomously; aggregators call it wheeled. No dimensions published.
changes.to: Scope review (#16, 2026-11-17): kept in scope, and kept under Humanoid because this catalog files wheeled humanoid-form robots here (Pepper, TIAGo Pro, Atlas on Wheels). It is not an AOI station: CasiVision VP Shen Fei describes it as 自主移动 / 自主移动巡检 (moves and patrols on its own) and the maker's site lists it under 具身质检设备 (embodied inspection equipment) - human-like dual arms and a multispectral head on a base the press calls wheeled. Locomotion left null: the maker states autonomous movement but not the drive type, and no datasheet is published. Not related to CASBOT despite similar names (some aggregators conflate them). Launched Aug 19, 2025; mass production from June 16, 2026.
